core_obligations: Construct the naive cotangent complex via a chart presentation of the morphism.
Identify its cohomology sheaves with those computed on the chart and deduce quasi-coherence.

proof_roadmap.step: Set up a chart presentation and the associated naive cotangent complex.
Identify the cohomology sheaves with the chart computation.
Conclude quasi-coherence from the description by differentials and conormal sheaves.

difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that the cohomology sheaves of the naive cotangent complex of a morphism of algebraic spaces are quasi-coherent. The proof constructs the naive cotangent complex through a chart presentation, identifies its cohomology sheaves with the corresponding sheaves computed on the chart, and uses that those are quasi-coherent because they are built from modules of differentials and conormal sheaves of etale-local presentations. Tracking the identification of the cohomology sheaves across the chart is the substance. Retained author proof at lines 5397-5403 with the surrounding argument.

dedup.scope: Cross-chapter same-name pair decided by the statements alone: both sides assert the same conclusion that the cohomology sheaves of the naive cotangent complex are quasi-coherent. This side is the more general statement (algebraic spaces over S) and carries the genuine 17-line proof, so it is the side counted. Compared against all focused-seeds task.json, PREPARATION_WORKLIST.jsonl, and public intervals for spaces-more-morphisms.tex.

compared.difference: Hypothesis difference: the schemes side is stated for morphisms of schemes; this side for morphisms of algebraic spaces over S. Conclusion difference: none, both conclude quasi-coherence of the cohomology sheaves of the naive cotangent complex.
